recipes.name: Spaghetti Carbonara
recipes.description: A classic Italian pasta dish made with simple ingredients.
steps: Cook the spaghetti in salted boiling water until al dente.
Crisp the pancetta in a frying pan over medium heat.
Whisk the eggs and cheese together in a bowl.
Combine the drained pasta with pancetta and mix with the egg mixture.
Serve with freshly ground pepper and extra cheese.

recipes.name: Vegan Buddha Bowl
recipes.description: A nutritious and colorful bowl packed with wholesome ingredients.

ingredients.title: Quinoa
ingredients.details: 1 cup, cooked according to package instructions.

ingredients.title: Chickpeas
ingredients.details: 1 cup of canned or cooked chickpeas.

steps: Cook the quinoa according to package instructions.
Roast the sweet potato until tender.
Assemble the quinoa, chickpeas, and sweet potato in a bowl.
Top with your favorite dressing and serve.

recipes.name: Chocolate Lava Cake
recipes.description: A rich and decadent dessert with a molten chocolate center.
steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C (400°F). Grease ramekins with butter and dust with cocoa powder.
Melt the chocolate and butter together until smooth. Let it cool slightly.
Whisk the eggs, yolks, and sugar until pale and fluffy. Fold in the chocolate mixture.
Gently fold in the flour until fully combined.
Pour the mixture into the prepared ramekins and bake for 10-12 minutes.
Let the cakes cool for 1 minute, then carefully invert onto plates. Serve immediately.
